title: Advanced Multi-Agent Orchestration & Topologies
audience: AI Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads
summary: Architecting robust multi-agent systems with hierarchical delegation, immutable memory boundaries, consensus ensembles, and framework mappings.
learningObjectives: Implement supervisor, router, and peer-to-peer multi-agent topologies
Enforce strict memory boundaries and immutable context handoffs between agents
Construct debate, critique, and verification ensembles for high-stakes tasks
Map agentic architectural patterns to LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel
Implement circuit breakers and bounded execution limits to prevent runaway loops

requiredSections.title: 1. Multi-Agent Topologies & Orchestration Patterns
requiredSections.guidance: Compare Supervisor/Workers, Router, and Peer-to-Peer agent swarms. Explain message passing, latency trade-offs, and state synchronization.

requiredSections.title: 2. Context Isolation & Immutable State Handoffs
requiredSections.guidance: Explain why shared mutable memory leads to context drift and hallucination cascades. Provide working TypeScript code showing immutable state passing.

requiredSections.title: 3. Debate, Critique & Consensus Ensembles
requiredSections.guidance: Detail how multi-model verification ensembles (drafter, verifier, adversary, arbiter) operate. Explain how to resolve conflicting agent conclusions without infinite loops.

requiredSections.title: 4. Framework Mapping: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
requiredSections.guidance: Provide side-by-side architectural mappings of the bounded supervisor pattern across LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI.

handsOnLab.title: Hands-On Lab: Build and Defend a Multi-Agent Supervisor Swarm
steps: Step 1: Set up the supervisor and two specialized subagents (researcher and validator).
Step 2: Implement strict state passing using an immutable task context object.
Step 3: Add a step counter circuit breaker capped at 5 total agent turns.
Step 4: Execute the test suite and verify that tasks complete with verified artifacts.
